title: Buddy AGI Actions Mission Control
principle: Build measurable capability, not an unsupported AGI claim.

goals.name: Reasoning & Planning
goals.description: Decompose goals, plan steps, manage constraints and revise plans from evidence.

goals.name: Best-Agent Routing
goals.description: Select the strongest available specialist for every meaningful step using task-specific evidence.

goals.name: Software Engineering
goals.description: Understand, build, test, debug, review and document repository changes.

goals.name: CI & Reliability
goals.description: Monitor workflows, diagnose failures, verify repairs and protect stable paths.

goals.name: Benchmark Mastery
goals.description: Measure correctness, quality, speed, safety and reliability with repeatable evidence.

goals.name: Continuous Learning
goals.description: Turn successful and failed attempts into lessons, regression tests and routing evidence.

goals.name: Knowledge & Research
goals.description: Gather, verify, cite and organize current information while separating facts from estimates.

goals.name: Memory & Context
goals.description: Maintain useful task context, project history and user-approved preferences with privacy boundaries.

goals.name: Multimodal Understanding
goals.description: Coordinate text, images, audio, documents and structured data when supported.

goals.name: Navigation & Travel
goals.description: Support voice-first routing, route alternatives, transportation planning and safe interaction while traveling.

goals.name: Business Builder
goals.description: Research opportunities, build workflows, analyze costs and prepare user-approved business plans.

goals.name: Authorized Device Center
goals.description: Discover and control compatible user-authorized devices through supported local/vendor interfaces.

goals.name: Developer Copilot
goals.description: Make GitHub concepts beginner-friendly while retaining professional engineering workflows.

goals.name: Security & Governance
goals.description: Protect secrets, permissions, privacy, dependencies, users and consequential actions.

goals.name: Beginner Experience
goals.description: Make every complex capability understandable and recoverable for first-time users.

goals.name: Observability
goals.description: Track health, latency, cost, errors, capability drift and evidence across the system.

goals.name: Build & Distribution
goals.description: Produce reproducible releases, device packages and beginner-friendly installation paths.

goals.name: Professional Help Routing
goals.description: Connect users to appropriate professionals when a task needs human expertise or approval.

goals.name: Creative Studio
goals.description: Support approved creative workflows such as writing, music, media planning and production assistance.

goals.name: Human Control
goals.description: Keep consequential decisions, permissions and irreversible actions under explicit user policy.

mastery_rule: A capability is not labeled Mastered from one successful run. It needs repeated task-relevant evidence, regression protection, acceptable safety and reliability, and a documented limitation profile.
routing_rule: Buddy may use one or many specialists. Agent selection is re-evaluated at meaningful task boundaries.
safety_rule: Inspection and sandboxing can be automated; consequential writes, deployments, financial actions, communications, account changes and device controls follow configured approval policies.
